paper.title: A structural closure of growth-sector couplings between discrete gravity and cosmology
paper.author: Morten Magnusson

C_grid_AQUAL.description: Grid-AQUAL converged prefactor; controls effective gravitational amplitude in MOND-like regime

g_over_G_at_a0p5.description: Ratio g/G at a=0.5, showing memory kernel is smoother and delayed

A.name: Multiplicative Geff
A.description: Poisson source modified by Geff/G = 1 + (C^2 - 1) g(a) s(k)

B.name: Local friction
B.description: Friction augmented by beta*g(a)/a on the velocity term

C.name: Non-local memory friction
C.description: Friction augmented by beta*G(a)/a using integrated gate kernel; breaks Markov evolution

data_sets_used: f*sigma8 compilation with BOSS DR12 covariance
EG statistic from five published measurements

key_result.description: All three coupling classes are either structurally excluded or absorbed by the Omega_m-coupling degeneracy once geometry is locked by BAO+H(z). EG with Sigma=1 carries no independent information beyond f*sigma8. Growth observables alone are insufficient to discriminate this theory class.

Sigma_EG.description: Gravitational slip parameter fixed to 1 (GR value); EG then collapses to Omega_m0 / f(z)
